#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    int count = 0;
    if (!line.empty() && line.length() > 1) {
        size_t start = 0;
        while (start < line.length()) {
            size_t end = start + 1;
            while (end < line.length() && line[end] == line[end - 1]) {
                end++;
            }
            if ((end - start) % 2 == 0) {
                count++;
            }
            start = end;
        }
    }

    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
